mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and can cause photosensitivity; chlorpromazine is metabolized by CYP450 enzymes and isotretinoin may inhibit certain CYP pathways, potentially increasing chlorpromazine levels.
action: Monitor liver function tests regularly; advise strict sun protection for both drugs; consider alternative antipsychotic if hepatic impairment develops; ensure adequate contraception with isotretinoin.
